machine_types_payment_check.name: machine_types_payment_check
machine_types_payment_check.value: "modulus"."machine_types"."deposit_pct" between 0 and 100 and "modulus"."machine_types"."delivery_pct" between 0 and 100 and "modulus"."machine_types"."acceptance_pct" between 0 and 100 and "modulus"."machine_types"."deposit_pct" + "modulus"."machine_types"."delivery_pct" + "modulus"."machine_types"."acceptance_pct" = 100

machine_versions_dates_check.name: machine_versions_dates_check
machine_versions_dates_check.value: ("modulus"."machine_versions"."state" = 'draft') = ("modulus"."machine_versions"."published_at" is null) and ("modulus"."machine_versions"."state" = 'retired') = ("modulus"."machine_versions"."retired_at" is not null)

option_bom_deltas_shape_check.name: option_bom_deltas_shape_check
option_bom_deltas_shape_check.value:
("modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."op" = 'remove' and "modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."quantity" is null and "modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."replaces" is null)
    or ("modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."op" = 'add' and "modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."quantity" > 0 and "modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."unit" is not null and "modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."replaces" is null)
    or ("modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."op" = 'replace' and "modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."quantity" > 0 and "modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."unit" is not null and "modulus"."option_bom_deltas"."replaces" is not null)

option_rules_shape_check.name: option_rules_shape_check
option_rules_shape_check.value:
("modulus"."option_rules"."kind" = 'mandatory_if' and "modulus"."option_rules"."target_option_id" is null and "modulus"."option_rules"."condition_key" is not null and "modulus"."option_rules"."condition_op" is not null and "modulus"."option_rules"."condition_value" is not null)
    or ("modulus"."option_rules"."kind" <> 'mandatory_if' and "modulus"."option_rules"."target_option_id" is not null and "modulus"."option_rules"."target_option_id" <> "modulus"."option_rules"."option_id" and "modulus"."option_rules"."condition_key" is null and "modulus"."option_rules"."condition_op" is null and "modulus"."option_rules"."condition_value" is null)

price_lists_validated_check.name: price_lists_validated_check
price_lists_validated_check.value: ("modulus"."price_lists"."state" in ('published', 'withdrawn')) = ("modulus"."price_lists"."validated_at" is not null and "modulus"."price_lists"."validated_by_name" is not null)

deals_case_shape_check.name: deals_case_shape_check
deals_case_shape_check.value: ("modulus"."deals"."sale_case" = 2) = ("modulus"."deals"."intermediary_id" is not null) and ("modulus"."deals"."sale_case" = 1 or "modulus"."deals"."capex_need" is null)

deals_probability_check.name: deals_probability_check
deals_probability_check.value: "modulus"."deals"."probability" between 0 and 100 and ("modulus"."deals"."state" <> 'won' or "modulus"."deals"."probability" = 100) and ("modulus"."deals"."state" not in ('lost', 'abandoned') or "modulus"."deals"."probability" = 0)

deals_loss_check.name: deals_loss_check
deals_loss_check.value: ("modulus"."deals"."state" in ('lost', 'abandoned')) = ("modulus"."deals"."loss_reason" is not null) and ("modulus"."deals"."loss_reason" is null or "modulus"."deals"."loss_reason" in ('price', 'lead_time', 'technical', 'competitor', 'project_abandoned', 'other'))

feedback_options_values_check.name: feedback_options_values_check
feedback_options_values_check.value: "modulus"."feedback_options"."budget_keur" >= 0 and ("modulus"."feedback_options"."actual_keur" is null or "modulus"."feedback_options"."actual_keur" >= 0) and ("modulus"."feedback_options"."delivered" or "modulus"."feedback_options"."actual_keur" is null)

offers_currency_check.name: offers_currency_check
offers_currency_check.value: "modulus"."offers"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' and (("modulus"."offers"."state" = 'draft' and "modulus"."offers"."rate" is null) or ("modulus"."offers"."state" <> 'draft' and ("modulus"."offers"."currency" = 'EUR') = ("modulus"."offers"."rate" is null))) and ("modulus"."offers"."rate" is null or "modulus"."offers"."rate" > 0)

offers_frozen_shape_check.name: offers_frozen_shape_check
offers_frozen_shape_check.value:
("modulus"."offers"."state" = 'draft') = ("modulus"."offers"."content" is null) and ("modulus"."offers"."state" = 'draft') = ("modulus"."offers"."sent_on" is null)
    and ("modulus"."offers"."state" = 'draft') = ("modulus"."offers"."total_sale_keur" is null) and ("modulus"."offers"."state" = 'draft') = ("modulus"."offers"."sent_by_name" is null) and ("modulus"."offers"."state" = 'draft') = ("modulus"."offers"."lead_weeks" is null)

offers_totals_check.name: offers_totals_check
offers_totals_check.value: ("modulus"."offers"."total_sale_keur" is null or "modulus"."offers"."total_sale_keur" > 0) and ("modulus"."offers"."total_budget_keur" is null or "modulus"."offers"."total_budget_keur" >= 0)

project_feedback_values_check.name: project_feedback_values_check
project_feedback_values_check.value:
"modulus"."project_feedback"."material_keur" >= 0 and "modulus"."project_feedback"."subcontracting_keur" >= 0 and "modulus"."project_feedback"."engineering_keur" >= 0 and "modulus"."project_feedback"."workshop_keur" >= 0
    and "modulus"."project_feedback"."site_keur" >= 0 and "modulus"."project_feedback"."expenses_keur" >= 0 and "modulus"."project_feedback"."engineering_hours" >= 0 and "modulus"."project_feedback"."workshop_hours" >= 0 and "modulus"."project_feedback"."site_hours" >= 0

quote_estimates_values_check.name: quote_estimates_values_check
quote_estimates_values_check.value:
"modulus"."quote_estimates"."material_keur" >= 0 and "modulus"."quote_estimates"."subcontracting_keur" >= 0 and "modulus"."quote_estimates"."engineering_hours" >= 0 and "modulus"."quote_estimates"."workshop_hours" >= 0
    and "modulus"."quote_estimates"."site_hours" >= 0 and "modulus"."quote_estimates"."expenses_keur" >= 0 and "modulus"."quote_estimates"."sale_keur" > 0 and "modulus"."quote_estimates"."extra_weeks" between 0 and 104 and "modulus"."quote_estimates"."validity_days" between 1 and 365

quote_requests_origin_shape_check.name: quote_requests_origin_shape_check
quote_requests_origin_shape_check.value: ("modulus"."quote_requests"."origin" = 'deal' and "modulus"."quote_requests"."deal_id" is not null) or ("modulus"."quote_requests"."origin" = 'arche' and "modulus"."quote_requests"."capex_need" is not null)

quote_requests_feasibility_check.name: quote_requests_feasibility_check
quote_requests_feasibility_check.value:
("modulus"."quote_requests"."feasibility" is null or "modulus"."quote_requests"."feasibility" in ('feasible', 'to_study', 'refused'))
    and ("modulus"."quote_requests"."proposed_level" is null or "modulus"."quote_requests"."proposed_level" in ('mastered', 'done', 'sold', 'quoted', 'never', 'avoid'))
    and (("modulus"."quote_requests"."feasibility" is null) = ("modulus"."quote_requests"."qualified_on" is null)) and ("modulus"."quote_requests"."state" = 'qualification' or "modulus"."quote_requests"."state" = 'cancelled' or "modulus"."quote_requests"."feasibility" is not null)
